blockers.description: Task 5 quality review proved markers in files the go tool never executes (testdata/*_test.go outside the contracts branch, _-prefixed files/dirs) could satisfy active C-IDs — the same dead-file hole design §3.1 explicitly closes for testdata/fuzz. Resolved by system_one decision exclude-dead-dirs (0.78) while status=planned: trace now excludes testdata/ (contracts branch unchanged) and any _-prefixed path element from marker sources, following the design's own corpus rationale; the plan's Task-5 prose (fence-adjudicated pathSkipped adaptation, recorded in the feat commit body) and design §3.1 stay unedited outside allowedFiles, so this record bridges the drift. Follow-up recorded for design: the testdata exclusion is root-anchored (strings.HasPrefix(rel,'testdata/')) while _ is any-depth; go tool ignores testdata at ANY depth, so a future nested testdata/ dir needs a conscious design decision (repo has exactly one, root-level). Also bridges stale plan counts in close bodies: plan says 40 tests / 67 selftest; actuals 54 top-level / 71 leaf and selftest 68.
